name: Steward Corvane
title: Steward of Tricode

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Another of the Benefactor's heroes. Welcome to Tricode, the finest city in Trifectia, whatever Argon says.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: The Hall keeps the roads, the walls and the lamps. The Cathedral keeps everything else. Try to stay on the right side of both.

chatter: Has anyone seen the minutes from the last council?
Mind the clock. It strikes louder than you think.
